content:
Samir: Heads-up: we're adding an "ephemeral unwrap" circuit-breaker for BYOK requests at the edge. Need quick design review before tomorrow's deploy.
Priya: Outline?
Samir: Short: 1) if approval service latency > 500ms OR error rate > 5% for tenant -> edge enters circuit-open for 60s, 2) when open deny unwraps and return 403 + audit entry, 3) fallback path for legacy tenants to use synchronous KMS proxy (no unwrap).
Lena: Question: does denying unwrap violate any contract for Dedicated customers who expect availability? We should allow per-tenant opt-out flag (allow_unwrap_during_cb) gated by contract.
Priya: Good call. Also need to add these fields to audit log: `cb_state`, `cb_trigger_metric`, `approval_latency_ms`, `approval_http_code`, `tenant_flag_overrides`.
Samir: Agree. Implementation notes: - circuit tracked per-tenant+region - use token bucket for approval attempts to avoid thundering herd - track consecutive failures window 1m.
Lena: KMS integration: proxies must still be able to call into customer KMS for unwraps if tenant opted out. That flow requires explicit RBAC role `byok_unwrap_override`. Add a short-lived grant (max 2h) issued via internal CA.
Priya: Security: require mTLS + cert pinning between edge proxy and approval service. Also sign the audit events with the proxy's key so we can detect forged logs.
Samir: For vuln triage: if an attacker floods approvals and trips CB repeatedly, we should surface anomaly to SIEM with `approval_attempts_window` > threshold and create an auto incident with severity S2.
deploy-bot: rolling deploy queued: approval-service:v1.12 -> canary (region: us-east) :rocket:
Lena: Incident response sketch: 1) transition CB to manual-open and collect last 5min of approvals, 2) rotate approval-service client cert, 3) invalidate any active `byok_unwrap_override` grants, 4) notify compliance + legal if unwraps happened during incident.
Priya: Retention: store approval/audit events for 180 days for enterprise tenants, 90 days for others. Exportable CSV via console for audits.
Samir: Logging format example (pseudo): `ts|tenant|operator|action|cb_state|lat_ms|http_code|req_id|attest_sha256`. Keep lines small to avoid log bloat.
Lena: Backwards compatibility: proxies should send `x-approval-schema: v2` header. If approval service doesn't understand v2, proxy should fallback to legacy flow but emit `compat_fallback=true` in audit.
Priya: Ops note: rotate the approval API token daily; use KMS-wrapped ephemeral tokens for deploy agents. Document token revocation steps in runbook.
Samir: I'll open PRs: 1) edge proxy changes (CB + headers + audit fields), 2) auth server: support `byok_unwrap_override` grant issuance, 3) audit pipeline: new schema + retention. ETA EOD.
Lena: I'll draft the short runbook and add the per-tenant opt-out into contract checklist.
Priya: I'll write the mTLS + cert-pinning spec and coord with infra for cert rotation automation.
Samir: Thanks. Action items summarized: Samir -> PRs for proxy + auth + audit, Lena -> runbook + contract opt-out, Priya -> mTLS/cert rotation. Ping @eng-oncall when canary is up.
